samples.label: clean
samples.code:
<?php
function getOrder($order_id, $user_id) {
    global $db;
    $stmt = $db->prepare('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?');
    $stmt->execute([$order_id, $user_id]);
    return $stmt->fetch();
}
?>
